oneLiner: Arguably the best operating metrics in software (Rule of 40 = 155, +93% growth at $8B scale) attached to the most expensive multiple in large-cap software (~50x forward sales).
thesis: AIP is winning the enterprise agentic-AI land grab: US commercial +149% YoY with 157% net dollar retention and accelerating sequential growth.
Government is an annuity with upside: $10B/10-year Army Enterprise Agreement, NATO Maven purchases, NGC2 and Golden Dome positioning; US government +90% YoY.
Ontology layer creates deep switching costs: data, logic, and actions bound into operational workflows; NDR is the evidence.
Margins already elite: 62% adjusted operating margin, $4.5-4.7B FCF guided for FY2026; the entire question is what multiple to pay.

latestQuarter.label: Q2 2026 (reported Aug 3, 2026)
points: Adjusted operating margin 62%; GAAP operating margin 47%; GAAP net margin 55% (incl. SpaceX marks).
Government $990M (+79%), US government $809M (+90%); US commercial $764M (+149% YoY, +28% seq).
Guide raised: FY2026 revenue $8.15B (+82%); US commercial >$3.42B (+134%); adjusted FCF $4.5-4.7B; Q3 ~$2.16B.

segments: Government ~51% of revenue: Army EA, NATO Maven, allied defense.
Commercial ~49%, with US commercial (+149%) the growth engine on AIP adoption.
competitive: Enterprise AI platforms: Databricks, Snowflake Cortex, Microsoft Fabric target the same data/AI budgets.
Defense tech: Anduril is partner and rival (joint $100M Army NGC2 win Jul 2026; Golden Dome co-development with Scale AI and SpaceX).
Big-3 consultancies compete for AI-implementation budgets; Palantir's forward-deployed model positions it as software, not billable hours.
C3.ai has faded as a serious threat.
moat: The ontology layer binding an institution's data, logic, and actions creates switching costs once operational workflows run through Foundry/AIP. In government: decades of accreditations, classified deployments, and contract vehicles newcomers cannot replicate quickly.
risks: Valuation: ~67x trailing EV/S is 150% above its own 10-year median; any growth wobble is severely punished.
Insider selling: Karp sold ~$54M in May 2026; insiders sold >$250M in late 2025; 34 sells, 0 buys in five years.
Government dependency: ~51% of revenue tied to US/allied budgets; a CR or budget fight hits the biggest segment.
Law of large numbers: +93% on an $8B base is unprecedented; 2027 comps get brutal.
Anduril tension could cap Palantir's share of next-gen defense programs.
SBC keeps GAAP margins (47%) well below adjusted (62%).
catalysts: US federal fiscal year-end Sept 30 award flow.
Golden Dome milestones; further NATO/allied Maven expansions.
pricedIn: ~82x forward earnings, ~50x forward sales. To justify it: hold 60%+ growth for years at ~60% adjusted margins, growing $8.15B toward ~$25B+ by 2029-2030, which brings EV/S toward ~17x on out-year sales. Bulls: Q2's +93% proves the AI-operating-system thesis. Bears: even perfection is fully paid for at ~$420B.

scenarios.bear: US commercial growth halves as AIP pilots saturate and Databricks/Snowflake/Fabric win mainstream; a 2027 budget impasse freezes government; NDR fades to 120%. Growth of 'only' 40% forces the multiple from ~50x toward 15-20x forward sales: a 50-60% derating even with rising earnings.
scenarios.base: FY2026 lands at $8.15B (+82%); 2027 decelerates to 45-60% at ~60% adjusted margins and $4.5B+ FCF; multiple compresses gradually as earnings grow into it; stock oscillates in the established $130-210 range with earnings-driven spikes.
scenarios.bull: AI agents in production become the enterprise standard with AIP the category winner; US commercial sustains >100% into 2027; Golden Dome and NGC2 convert into multi-billion production programs; revenue triples by 2028-29 and growth outruns multiple compression.

valPresets.note: Even the bear preset needs 25% year-1 FCF growth; the reverse DCF shows ~30%+ constant growth for a decade is priced in. That asymmetry is the entire PLTR debate.

latestProse: Q2 2026 (reported Aug 3). Revenue $1.94B +93% (consensus ~$1.80B); adjusted operating margin 62%, GAAP operating margin 47%. US commercial $764M, +149% YoY and +28% sequential; US government $809M, +90%. Net dollar retention 157%, up 700bp sequentially. Rule of 40 score: 155.
guidanceProse: FY2026 raised to $8.15B (+82%); US commercial guided above $3.42B (+134%); adjusted FCF $4.5-4.7B; Q3 ~$2.16B. At ~50x forward sales the guide has to keep being beaten, not merely met - every quarter is a referendum on the multiple.
